title: Dusty Depot
subtitle: Trees, a port-a-potty, and absolutely no oil.

infobox.Amenities: One port-a-potty, trees, a lawn chair

quote.text: Well Kanye ever since we got teleported into dusty depot we haven't had a ounce of oil for our business, its left us broke and big sad

lead: **Dusty Depot** is a location where [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]], [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] and [[walter-white|Walter White]] become stranded after being teleported there in the [[crack-van|RV of time]]. It is the site of the trio's failed search for an [[oil]] deposit, and, through a port-a-potty of extraordinary versatility, the gateway to [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]].

sections.heading: Description
sections.body:
Canon describes Dusty Depot sparingly. It contains at least one port-a-potty, a lawn, and trees, which Walter White gazes up into from his lawn chair. The trio's RV is parked there and is noted to be "damaged".

No oil deposit is ever located in Dusty Depot, despite the crew being "in the middle of searching for a oil deposit in dusty depot as their oil ran out."

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
### Arrival
According to Hank in [[chapter-maybe-seventh]], the crew "got teleported into dusty depot". How or why this happened is never explained. Their last known whereabouts before this were fleeing the [[department-of-defense|Department of Defense]] and [[weezing-of-kanye|weezing Kanye]] in [[chapter-the-fourth]].

### The supply run
While Hank "smoked a fat one" outside the RV, Jesse used the [[port-a-potty-portal|port-a-potty]] to travel to a [[quick-check|Quick-Check]], returning with 2 [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dews]] and a pack of [[zyn|zyns]]. The Quick-Check's clerk tipped him off about a nearby oil casino.

### Erger Wings
While waiting for Hank to fetch his [[nfts|NFTs]], Walter shared his retirement dream: to open a Mountain Dew refinery and restaurant chain in Dusty Depot called [[erger-wings|Erger Wings]].

### Departure
Jesse then "ripped open the porta-potty door revealing a bright portal made of swirls and particle effects", and the trio left Dusty Depot for the casino.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- Hank opens the scene by saying "we ran out of propane", but the narration says it was their oil that ran out.
- The vehicle is called "the rv of time" here, but it was a "drug van", a "crack van" and a "bus" in [[chapter-the-fourth]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Dusty Depot shares its name with a well-known named location in the video game [[fortnite|Fortnite]]. This, along with the [[golden-scar|Golden SCAR]], is often cited as evidence that this whole part of the canon takes place near the Fortnite map.
- It is one of the few locations in the canon with trees.

title: The Port-a-Potty Portal
subtitle: A port-a-potty that goes places.

quote.text: Today we become rich
quote.by: Jesse Pinkman, "in a breathless airy voice"

lead: The **Port-a-Potty Portal** is a port-a-potty in [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]] that functions as a means of travel. It is the most efficient transit system depicted in the canon, outperforming the [[inav|Inav]] on convenience if not on Diet Dr Pepper service.

sections.heading: Uses
sections.body:
The port-a-potty is used twice in [[flashback-chapter]]:

- [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] "used a port-a-potty to go to a quick-check to score some Doritos", returning out of it with 2 [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dews]] and a pack of [[zyn|zyns]].
- Jesse later "ripped open the porta-potty door revealing a bright portal made of swirls and particle effects." [[walter-white|Walter White]] jumped in first, followed by Jesse and [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]], and the three arrived in the vast [[the-67-casino|6 7 Casino]].

sections.heading: Behind the scenes
sections.body:
- It is unclear whether the port-a-potty always contained a portal, or whether it can be tuned to different destinations. Fans note that Jesse never mentions a portal on his first trip, implying the Quick-Check route was simply normal port-a-potty behaviour.
- "Swirls and particle effects" is the only description of a [[the-wormhole|wormhole]]-like effect in the canon that sounds like a video game settings menu.

title: The Quick-Check
subtitle: Grub, intel, and nicotine pouches.

quote.text: Got some grub dude, yo the clerk told me that there's a oil casino nearby

lead:
The **Quick-Check** is a convenience store visited by [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] via the [[port-a-potty-portal|port-a-potty]] in [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]]. Jesse went there "to score some Doritos" and came back with 2 [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dews]] and a pack of [[zyn|zyns]]. Whether he actually got the Doritos is never confirmed.

Its unnamed clerk is responsible for one of the most consequential tips in the canon: telling Jesse "that there's a oil casino nearby", which led directly to the crew guarding the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]] at [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The name resembles QuickChek, a real convenience store chain in New Jersey, the home state of [[newark|Newark]], birthplace of [[chris|Chris]].
- Along with the [[corner-store-ohio|Corner Store (Ohio)]] and Plankton's favourite corner store in [[chai-town|Chai Town]], it is one of several corner stores that quietly shape the plot.

title: Erger Wings
subtitle: A Mountain Dew refinery and restaurant. Coming eventually.

quote.text: You know when we grow old Jesse.. I would like to open up a mountain dew refinery and restaurant here, we'll make it a chain.. call it erger wings..

lead: **Erger Wings** is [[walter-white|Walter White]]'s dream business: a [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dew]] refinery and restaurant, to be opened in [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]] when he and [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] "grow old", and later expanded into a chain. Walter shares the idea while sitting on a lawn chair looking up at the trees. Jesse's only response is to nod.

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body:
The concept of *refining* Mountain Dew is consistent with later canon, in which the 360 Chambers contain pipes of Mountain Dew described as "an organic substance that has the power to make you super human, or super dead", and a door smothered in "mountain dew oil". This suggests Mountain Dew is, in-universe, a natural resource.

The meaning of "Erger" is never explained. **Fan theory:** some readers believe it is a misspelling of "burger"; others insist it is a real word that Walter, a former chemistry teacher, simply knows and we don't.

title: The 6 7 Casino
subtitle: Taller than the wideness of the tall.

quote.text: This truly is one of the best casinos ive seen in a millennia, ever since that one in Vegas closed.

lead: **The 6 7 Casino** is an oil casino in [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99, the Gambling Addiction Sector]]. It is home to the [[verizon-contract|3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]], an ancient relic that generates the [[field-of-gambling|Field of Gambling]] allowing its patrons to gamble at all. It is the setting of [[the-boys|the Boys']] [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]].

sections.heading: Description
sections.body:
### Exterior
Seen from the [[inav|Inav]] at evening, "the casino was taller than the wideness of the tall, and it was a sight to behold". [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] described it as "bussin' for real on Geoffrey". Its walls are made of "pale beige brick", which is soft enough to be cut by the [[facetime-laser|Ultra Mega Uber Cool FaceTime Laser]].

### Interior
When [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew arrived through the [[port-a-potty-portal|port-a-potty]], they found "a vast casino lined with slot machines, gold decor", and [[jeffrey-epstein-statue|statues]] of three public figures. The casino contains "elegant hallways", long enough that reaching the roulette room left the crew "panting from the marathon".

### Lower chambers
A side staircase called the [[stairway-to-heaven|Stairway to Heaven]] leads down to the lower chambers and [[the-vault|the Vault]], a "giant freaking door" behind which the relic is kept.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body:
- [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]], trained warriors posted in the underground hallways.
- [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]], who appears to serve as a security guard.
- Hank Hill, Jesse and Walter, hired by [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]] for one night in exchange for 15 gallons of Prime US [[oil]].
- Alarms, and a "protection system" that fires on intruders. Its bullets bounced off the Inav.
- Staff are apparently issued [[golden-scar|golden scars]].

sections.heading: History
sections.body: The casino's relic was "recovered from the ruins of the [[la-walmart|LA Walmart]]". During the night of the heist, the Vault was opened by the [[ibeam|Ibeam]], leaving "a large hole" in the building through which moonlight came in. The fate of the casino after the relic was removed is unknown, but since the Field of Gambling only exists around a building containing the relic, fans assume gambling there has stopped.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- The name refers to the "6 7" meme. The number 67 recurs throughout the canon: "67 ioann rizz", a "67gb micro sd card", and the typo "almo7st".
- It is called an "oil casino" by the Quick-Check clerk, but no oil-based gambling is ever shown.
- ChatGPT claims to have seen casinos for "a millennia", raising questions about its age (see [[bings-son|Bing's Son]]).

title: Microsoft Bing
subtitle: Search engine. Robot. Father. Casino guardian.

quote.text: Well sir it seems you ended up at the right place at the right time, my name is Microsoft bing. And I need your help.

lead: **Microsoft Bing** is a large robot associated with [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]], who hires [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]], [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] and [[walter-white|Walter White]] to guard the casino's relic, the [[verizon-contract|3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]].

sections.heading: Appearance
sections.body: Bing has "two wheel for movement, two robotic arms and a giant tv for a body". He is able to turn to look at people, suggesting the TV may display a face, though this is not stated.

sections.heading: Role in the story
sections.body:
Bing debuts by physically stopping the ball during [[roulette-bet|the Great Roulette Bet]] ("it was not stopped by the board but by a large robot"), meaning the result of the bet is never known.

He explains that "there is a group of individuals that include my son that intend on taking this casinos ancient relic that allows us to let our people gamble", and that the relic creates a [[field-of-gambling|Field of Gambling]] around any building it is in. Hank negotiates a fee of "15 gallons of your finest Prime US oil", which Bing calls "a high price" but agrees to "if your services are exceptional".

Bing then leads the crew down the [[stairway-to-heaven|Stairway to Heaven]] to the relic and leaves them to guard it overnight. Hank's crew later sided with the thieves in the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], so their services were arguably not exceptional, and the 15 gallons were presumably never paid.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Named after the real-world Microsoft search engine Bing.
- Bing's phrase "our people" implies he leads a community of gamblers, possibly the residents of [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99]].
- Bing does not appear during the heist itself.

title: Bing's Son
subtitle: The canon's greatest unsolved paternity case.

infobox.Affiliation: A group intending to steal the casino's relic

quote.text: there is a group of individuals that include my son that intend on taking this casinos ancient relic

lead: **Bing's Son** is the unnamed son of [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]]. According to his father, he is part of "a group of individuals" intending to steal the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]] from [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]]. The son is never identified, and the canon never returns to the subject.

sections.heading: Fan theories
sections.body:
Since the only group shown stealing the relic is [[the-boys|the Boys]] ([[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]]), fans have long debated which of them, if any, is Bing's son. *All of the following are theories, not canon.*

- **ChatGPT:** The most popular theory, since in the real world Microsoft is closely tied to the company behind ChatGPT and its technology powers Bing's chatbot. Supporters also point out that ChatGPT inexplicably says "Aight bet boss" in the scene where Bing hires Hank's crew, despite not being there, suggesting it was present in some capacity.
- **Steve Jobs:** Considered unlikely, given the historic rivalry between Apple and Microsoft. Supporters call this "exactly why it would be a twist".
- **Kanye West:** Has no evidence whatsoever.
- **Son S. Sonionring:** A fringe theory based entirely on the name of [[son-s-sonionring|Son S. Sonionring]]. Son is in the projects at the time and not involved in the heist.
- **A different group:** Some readers argue Bing was describing another gang entirely, who never showed up.

title: The Great Roulette Bet
subtitle: Several NFTs on red.

quote.text: Several NFTs on red!

lead:
**The Great Roulette Bet** was a wager placed by [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew upon arriving at [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]]. After a marathon through the casino's elegant hallways, the crew went to the first table they saw and exclaimed "Several NFTs on red!"

"Finally after an entire 4 minutes they had a bet in the casino, it was a heart wrenching experience but they have prevailed." Hank remarked, "Well I Say boy that there bet ought to be good there son." The ball "rolled.. and rolled.. and rolled…" before being stopped not by the board but by [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]]. The outcome of the bet remains unknown, and the [[nfts|NFTs]] are not mentioned again.

title: NFTs (Mysterious Apes)
subtitle: Mysterious apes on a bitcoin wallet.

infobox.Fate: Bet on red at [[roulette-bet|the Great Roulette Bet]]

quote.text: Well boy that sounds like a gosh dang good idea, I have some mysterious apes on my bitcoin Wallet let me go get it

lead: **NFTs** are digital assets that appear twice in the canon, both in [[flashback-chapter]].

sections.heading: Hank's mysterious apes
sections.body: When [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] asked "anyone got some nft's on their phone?" so the crew could gamble at the oil casino, [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] revealed he had "some mysterious apes on my bitcoin Wallet". He returned from the RV with what he called "a nice token right here". The crew then bet "Several NFTs on red!" at [[roulette-bet|the Great Roulette Bet]], whose result was never revealed.

sections.heading: The NFT collector
sections.body: During [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]], light refracting off his glasses bounced into a wormhole and blinded "an NFT collector in [[universe-prime|Universe Prime]]". **Fan theory:** some readers believe this collector was Hank, which would explain why he describes his own NFTs only as "mysterious".

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- "Mysterious apes" refers to the real-world fad of ape-themed NFT collections.
- It is unclear how a roulette table accepts NFTs, but within the [[field-of-gambling|Field of Gambling]] anything is presumably possible.

title: The Stairway to Heaven
subtitle: It goes down, actually.

quote.text: We call this the stairway to heaven boys, it goes down to the relic…..

lead:
**The Stairway to Heaven** is a side staircase off the main casino room of [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]], leading down to [[the-vault|the Vault]] containing the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]]. [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]] led Hank's crew to it, and they "did the crip walk slowly down the stairs" with their casino-issued [[golden-scar|scars]] and [[red-bull|red bulls]].

Despite its name, the stairway goes *down*. Wiki editors have noted that, given the relic is the source of all gambling in the casino, this may be the point. The name references the famous Led Zeppelin song.

It is likely the same "side door" stairwell that [[the-boys|the Boys]] "quickly scurried down" during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], and through which the [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]] later poured in.

title: The 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text
subtitle: The most valuable relic within 3 light years.

infobox.Also known as: The verison gift card; the ancient redeemable card; the gift card; the relic
infobox.Type: Ancient relic / phone plan / gift card
infobox.Origin: Recovered from [[la-walmart|the ruins of the LA Walmart]]

quote.text: This ancient redeemable card is the key to our casino, recovered from the ruins of the LA Walmart its single handedly the most valuable relic within 3 light years of this planet

lead:
**The 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text** is an ancient relic and the central MacGuffin of the later canon. It is one of the components named in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]] as necessary to defeat [[chris|Chris]] on [[the-court|the court]].

In the book its name is always set apart, printed centered on its own lines in bold italics, in the form:

> "The 3 year contract plan from Verizon for unlimited talk and text"

This typographical reverence is extended to no other object, including the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]].

sections.heading: Names
sections.body:
The relic is referred to by several names:

- "3 year contract plan from version for unlimited talk and text" (sic), in [[chapter-triangle]]
- "the gift card" and, in a Steve Jobs aside, possibly "19 dollar fornite card, code: who wants it"
- "This ancient redeemable card", by [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]]
- "the verison gift card" (sic), by the narration and by Kanye
- "the relic" and "the artifact"

Whether the relic is a contract, a phone plan, or a gift card is the subject of ongoing editorial debate. The canon treats all three as the same thing.

sections.heading: History
sections.body:
### First mention
In [[chapter-triangle]], [[plankton|Plankton]] explains that the only person capable of battling Chris is one who has downloaded the sacred social media apps onto their [[nokia-i-4500|Nokia I-4500 flip phone]] "with android wireless technology and 3 year contract plan from version for unlimited talk and text with there cutting edge 3g network".

### The casino
The relic was "recovered from the ruins of the [[la-walmart|LA Walmart]]" and became "the key to" [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]], as it is "one of the few in the universe that can create a field of gambling around any building that it is contained in." Microsoft Bing hired [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew to guard it, warning "there will be hunters tonight".

### Liberation
In the [[flashback-chapter]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] orders [[siri|Siri]] to take the Inav to the Casino: "its time to liberate the gift card". In [[chapter-maybe-seventh]] he tells the [[the-boys|gangity gang]] that the relic "Resides here" and that with it "we have a shot at defeating Chris".

During the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], the [[ibeam|Ibeam]] blasted open [[the-vault|the Vault]], revealing the card "Glowing with a radiant golden light". [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] "grabbed the gift card and put it into his Yeezy jacket", and it was loaded into the [[inav|Inav]] "to keep it safe for now".

### Activation
On arrival in the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 Sector]], Steve Jobs "took out his iPhone and started entering the gift card code", as part of a plan to sync with [[flip-phone-covenant|the Flip Phone Covenant]] without triggering [[5g|5G]].

### The Prophecy
In [[chapter-4-point-1]], [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] recites the Prophecy, which lists the relic alongside the [[sacred-apps|Sacred Apps]], Apple Podcasts 2 and Settings (Full access) as what a phone must contain to beat Chris.

sections.heading: Powers
sections.body:
- Generates a [[field-of-gambling|Field of Gambling]] around any building it is contained in.
- Glows with a radiant golden light.
- Is guarded by [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]], who are "trained warriors" deployed specifically to defend it.
- Has a redeemable code.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- "Verizon" is spelled "version" in [[chapter-triangle]] and "verison" in [[chapter-maybe-seventh]].
- Because the centered name already begins with "The", the book reads "the most remarkable, the / The 3 year contract plan..." and "Inside the vault they saw it.. the / The 3 year contract plan...", giving the relic two definite articles.
- In [[chapter-triangle]] the plan comes with a Nokia flip phone, but by [[chapter-maybe-seventh]] it is being entered into an iPhone 3G.
- The "19 dollar fornite card" may or may not be the same object.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- At the time of writing, no 3 year Verizon plan was known to generate gambling fields in the real world.
- Free "$10 Fortnite cards" were advertised in the skies of [[england|England]] in [[chapter-triangle]], suggesting a thriving gift-card economy across the multiverse.

title: The Ruins of the LA Walmart
subtitle: Archaeological site of note.
lead:
**The Ruins of the LA Walmart** are the site where the [[verizon-contract|3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]] was "recovered", according to [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]]. The canon says nothing else about them: not who recovered it, when the Walmart fell into ruin, or why.

The LA Walmart joins the [[abandoned-walmarts|Abandoned Walmarts]] of [[constantinople|Constantinople]] (where [[lightning-mcqueen|McQueen]] dropped off nukes) as evidence that Walmarts in the Legend of Chris universe are in widespread decline. Wiki editors have described the chain as the canon's foremost producer of ruins.

title: Field of Gambling
subtitle: Required for all gambling.

infobox.Source: [[verizon-contract|The 3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon]] and "few" other relics
infobox.Range: Any building the relic is contained in

quote.text: the relic is one of the few in the universe that can create a field of gambling around any building that it is contained in.

lead:
A **Field of Gambling** is a field created around any building containing certain relics, such as the [[verizon-contract|3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]]. According to [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]], the relic is what "allows us to let our people gamble", implying that gambling is not possible in the Legend of Chris universe without such a field.

Bing says the relic is "one of the few in the universe" with this power, meaning other gambling relics exist. **Fan theory:** "that one in Vegas", which ChatGPT says has closed, lost its relic.

It is unknown whether the field travelled with the card into the [[inav|Inav]], which would make the Inav a casino.

title: The Golden SCAR
subtitle: Casino-issued. No fear.

quote.text: They slowly reclined back.. slammed their red bulls and nodded off, in no fear, since their scars were gold…

lead:
The **Golden SCAR** is the casino-issued equipment given to [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew while guarding the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]]. The crew went down the [[stairway-to-heaven|Stairway to Heaven]] "with their casino issued scars and red bulls", and fell asleep "in no fear, since their scars were gold". In [[chapter-maybe-seventh]], Hank "grabbed his golden scar" when the alarms went off.

The gold SCAR is a famous legendary-rarity assault rifle in [[fortnite|Fortnite]], which, combined with the nearby [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]], suggests a Fortnite connection. A minority of readers maintain the crew were simply issued literal golden scars, which is also somehow consistent with the text. Despite being armed, Hank never fires it: the fighting is called off before he gets the chance.

title: Sector 1/99 (The Gambling Addiction Sector)
subtitle: Home of many great minds.

quote.text: Boys welcome to sector 1/99 the gambling addiction sector, this place was the homes of many great minds, Elon mush, Frodo Baggins, D. Piddy

lead:
**Sector 1/99**, also called **the Gambling Addiction Sector**, is the region of the multiverse containing [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]]. [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] welcomed [[the-boys|the gangity gang]] to it when the [[inav|Inav]] emerged from a wormhole.

Steve describes it as having been "the homes of many great minds": [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]], [[frodo|Frodo Baggins]] and [[d-piddy|D. Piddy]]. He adds that "over the years as balling has become compromised" it has declined, but that he has found "something the most remarkable" there: the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]].

The fraction "1/99" has never been explained. Fans note that two of its three great minds (Elon Mush, who died of [[nfl-poisoning|NFL poisoning]], and Frodo, who ate the universe) are origin-story figures, which places the sector's history in the deep past.

title: D. Piddy
subtitle: A great mind.
lead:
**D. Piddy** is mentioned exactly once in the canon, by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], as one of the "many great minds" who once lived in [[sector-1-99|Sector 1/99, the Gambling Addiction Sector]], alongside [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]] and [[frodo|Frodo Baggins]].

Nothing else is known of his life, work, or greatness. His name resembles a nickname of the real-world music mogul Sean Combs. He is the only one of the three great minds not to appear in the [[chapter-before-chapter-2|origin story]].

title: Vegas
subtitle: Closed.

quote.text: This truly is one of the best casinos ive seen in a millennia, ever since that one in Vegas closed.

lead:
**Vegas** is mentioned once, by [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]], when the [[inav|Inav]] arrives at [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]]. According to ChatGPT, the 6 7 Casino is one of the best it has seen "in a millennia, ever since that one in Vegas closed".

The canon does not say which Vegas casino is meant, when it closed, or why. Since real-world Las Vegas has many casinos, ChatGPT's apparent belief that there was only "that one" has puzzled editors. **Fan theory:** it closed after losing its [[field-of-gambling|Field of Gambling]] relic.

title: Yuno Miles
subtitle: The last rapper. Immortal. Historically ass.

quote.text: after the gawk-ination of 2039 he was the last rapper and he gained immortality.

lead: **Yuno Miles** is a rapper whose music [[the-boys|the Boys]] blast "In their earth pods pro .5's" as they sneak up on [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]]. Kanye, apparently unfamiliar, asks "The fuq is this kid bro".

sections.heading: Biography
sections.body:
According to [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], "after the gawk-ination of 2039 he was the last rapper and he gained immortality. Afterwards he got a cult following and started touring the universe, doing the very first verse-wide tour. Gangs from all over bought tickets for him, and eventually the verse-wide tour cemented him as a historically ass artist. That's why his music is still prominent even today."

Kanye's response was "The fuck does that mean [[kobe-bryant|Kobe Bryant]]".

Yuno Miles's music is still audible later in the chapter: Hank's crew wake "To the noise of alarms, truth social notifs and yuno miles", suggesting the Boys did not turn it down during the break-in.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Yuno Miles is a real-world rapper known online for intentionally absurd lyrics.
- Kanye, himself a rapper, does not recognise the last rapper. Fans attribute this to the story taking place before 2039 for Kanye, though Steve speaks of 2039 in the past tense. This is either a continuity error or time travel.
- "Historically ass" is a direct quote and should not be corrected.

title: The Gawk-ination of 2039
subtitle: An event that left one rapper standing.
lead:
**The Gawk-ination of 2039** is a historical event mentioned once, by [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], while explaining who [[yuno-miles|Yuno Miles]] is. After it, Yuno Miles "was the last rapper and he gained immortality".

The canon gives no further detail. What happened, why it affected only rappers, and how it led to immortality are all unknown. Editors note the date is in the future relative to most of the book's events, yet Steve speaks of it in the past tense, implying either that the story takes place after 2039 or that Steve, having been a hologram since the [[iphone-keynote|iPhone 3G Keynote]], experiences time unusually.

title: The Verse-Wide Tour
subtitle: The very first.

infobox.Legacy: Cemented Yuno Miles as "a historically ass artist"

lead:
**The Verse-Wide Tour** was the "very first verse-wide tour", undertaken by [[yuno-miles|Yuno Miles]] after he became the last rapper following [[gawk-ination-2039|the Gawk-ination of 2039]]. According to [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], "Gangs from all over bought tickets for him, and eventually the verse-wide tour cemented him as a historically ass artist. That's why his music is still prominent even today."

It is unclear whether "verse-wide" means universe-wide or multiverse-wide, or is a pun on rap verses. Given that the Legend of Chris multiverse includes at least the [[america-universe|America Universe]] and [[shadow-realm|the Shadow Realm]], the logistics would have been considerable.

title: Kobe Bryant
subtitle: Invoked, not present.

quote.text: The fuck does that mean Kobe Bryant

lead:
**Kobe Bryant** is mentioned exactly once in the canon, as part of [[kanye-west|Kanye West]]'s reaction to [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]]'s explanation of [[yuno-miles|Yuno Miles]]. After Steve called Yuno "a historically ass artist", Kanye "stood there a moment and exclaimed.. 'The fuck does that mean Kobe Bryant'".

Whether Kanye was addressing Steve as "Kobe Bryant" or using the name as an exclamation is unclear; Steve's response ("Guys please.. I think I found a way inside the casino") does not settle it. Kobe Bryant was a real-world basketball legend, making him one of several basketball references in a story about [[balling]].

title: Charlie Kirks
subtitle: There could be kirks anywhere.

quote.text: Okay boys, Be on earlert there could be kirks anywhere

lead: **Charlie Kirks** (plural; individually a **Kirk**) are "trained warriors" found defending the [[verizon-contract|verison gift card]] in the lower chambers of [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]]. They appear to exist in large numbers, as [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] warns that "there could be kirks anywhere".

sections.heading: Casino encounter
sections.body:
During the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] opened the door at the bottom of the stairwell and found "3-4 Charlie kirks" in the hallway. The Boys "deduced" that they "must be here to defend the verison gift card".

Steve Jobs leapt onto the first Kirk with his [[igun|Igun]] and incapacitated him. In response, "The other kirks quickly took out their T1 phones and opened their truth social accounts and started talking about the problem with abortion in democrats rans states." While they were posting, Kanye and ChatGPT incapacitated the other two with their newly acquired Iguns. The fight set off the casino alarms.

More Kirks later arrived through the stairwell as the gang escaped into the [[inav|Inav]]. [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] noticed "dead kirks to the left hallway".

sections.heading: Tactics
sections.body:
- Kirks respond to combat by opening [[truth-social|Truth Social]] on [[t1-phones|T1 phones]]. This is not effective.
- They appear in groups and are capable of hearing fights from elsewhere in the building.
- A variant, the [[police-kirks|Police Kirks]], can transform into police cars.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- Named after the American political commentator Charlie Kirk.
- "Count gang violence" is how Steve Jobs announces the fight; ChatGPT's "earlert" is not a real word.

title: Police Kirks
subtitle: Kirks, but cars.
lead:
**Police Kirks** are a variant of [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]] who serve as law enforcement at the [[projects-national-spaceport|Projects National Spaceport]]. During [[spaceport-chase|the Spaceport Breakout & O'Block Chase]], they pursued [[rfk|RFK]], [[plankton|Plankton]], [[ioannus-paranukus|Ioannus Paranukus]], [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] and [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] out of the building.

When the gang escaped in [[honda-accord-2005|Son's 2005 Honda Accord]], "The police kirks transformed into police cars and crashed through the front of the building and out into the road still in pursuit." [[son-s-sonionring|Son]] then activated a trunk-mounted machine gun firing "Little pellets of [[purple-juice|solidified purple juice]]", which "popped all of the tires". The narration adds that it "was truly amazing you should've been there."

Their transformation ability has led some fans to compare them to Transformers. It is not known whether ordinary Kirks can do this too.

title: T1 Phones
subtitle: Standard Kirk issue.
lead:
**T1 Phones** are the phones carried by [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]]. When [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] attacked the first Kirk during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], "The other kirks quickly took out their T1 phones and opened their truth social accounts" to post about politics, rather than fighting back. They were then incapacitated.

The name refers to the real-world T1 phone announced by Trump Mobile in 2025. In-universe, the T1 is the only phone in the canon not covered by [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]], [[flip-phone-covenant|the Flip Phone Covenant]], or Apple. Its use of [[truth-social|Truth Social]], promoted by [[trumpy-the-red|Trumpy the Red]] in [[chapter-2]], is consistent with that lore.

title: DJ Khaled
subtitle: Security guard. Lobster summoner. Recipient of a low taper fade.

quote.text: Hank let the security guard deal with this.. BRING OUT THE LOBSTER!!

lead: **DJ Khaled** (spelled "DJ kaled" in the canon) is a combatant at [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]] who appears during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], apparently as its security guard.

sections.heading: Role in the story
sections.body:
As [[walter-white|Mr. White]] ran toward the gunfire, "a hand was put on Mr.whites shoulder" and someone said "Hank let the security guard deal with this.. [[lobster|BRING OUT THE LOBSTER!!]]" DJ kaled then "jumped out from behind him with his dj set and laid out a sick beat with plenty of doros bass."

"Without hesitation [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] jumped at DJ kaled, but DJ kaled dodged it no problem." The fight then stopped when [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse]] recognised Kanye.

When [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] fired the [[ibeam|Ibeam]], there was "a giant flash" and "a huge massive low taper fade got put on DJ KALED". His status after the haircut is unknown.

sections.heading: Continuity errors
sections.body:
- The hand is on Mr. White's shoulder, but the speaker addresses Hank.
- It is never said who speaks the lobster line. Readers are split between DJ Khaled announcing himself in the third person and an unseen hype man.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- DJ Khaled is a real-world DJ and record producer known for shouting on his own tracks.
- "Doros bass" is believed to relate to [[doritos|Doritos]] ("doros").
- "Huge massive low taper fade" is a reference to the low taper fade meme.

title: The Casino Heist
subtitle: The journey to the court begins with a FaceTime laser.

infobox.Defenders: [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]], [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]], [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew, a protection system
infobox.Result: Relic obtained; truce between the two gangs; escape to the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 Sector]]

quote.text: If we can break in.. and get the gift card.. we have a shot at defeating Chris.. We'll have started our journey to the end of the drought, the journey to the court…

lead: **The Casino Heist** was the break-in at [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]] by [[the-boys|the Boys]] to obtain the [[verizon-contract|3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]], one of the items named in [[the-prophecy|the Prophecy]] as needed to defeat [[chris|Chris]]. It ended with the unexpected alliance of the Boys and [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew.

sections.heading: Background
sections.body: [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] first resolved "to liberate the gift card" while fleeing a collapsing [[gotham-city|Gotham City]] in the [[flashback-chapter]]. Meanwhile, [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]] had hired Hank Hill, [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] and [[walter-white|Walter White]] to guard the relic against "hunters", one of whom was said to be [[bings-son|his own son]].

sections.heading: The break-in
sections.body:
The [[inav|Inav]] circled the top of the casino for a 360 view, then landed in an alley in its walls. Steve, Kanye and GPT snuck out "blasting [[yuno-miles|yuno miles]]" and hugged the wall looking for a door. ChatGPT plugged into Steve's iPhone to power the [[facetime-laser|Ultra Mega Uber Cool FaceTime Laser]], which cut a hole in the pale beige brick.

Inside, the lights were off and the tables barren. The Boys went down a side stairwell toward the lower chambers.

sections.heading: The Kirk fight
sections.body: At the bottom of the stairwell Kanye found 3-4 [[charlie-kirks|Charlie Kirks]]. Steve announced "Alright boys, its time to count gang violence" and incapacitated the first with his [[igun|Igun]]. The rest got out their [[t1-phones|T1 phones]] to post on [[truth-social|Truth Social]], and Kanye and GPT took them out too. Alarms began to blare.

sections.heading: Standoff and truce
sections.body:
Hank's crew woke to "alarms, truth social notifs and yuno miles". Hank grabbed his [[golden-scar|golden scar]] and declared "Its FNAF up in this place yo!" [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]] was summoned with the cry "[[lobster|BRING OUT THE LOBSTER!!]]" and dodged a flying Kanye.

When Jesse recognised Kanye, the fighting paused. Hank explained the crew had no oil since being teleported to [[dusty-depot|Dusty Depot]]. Kanye revealed the card could help defeat Chris. Walter realised that without Chris "the oil reserves.. There would be plenty of them". Hank asked why the Boys needed oil given the [[yeezy-reserve|Yeezy reserve]], and ChatGPT replied that defeating Chris would also mean "less regulation in general, and in addition.. balling would be free." "The two gangs sat in silence", and Hank nodded to Jesse.

sections.heading: Opening the Vault
sections.body: Hank admitted "Nothing we have can get into" [[the-vault|the Vault]]. Steve placed an [[airtag|AirTag]] on the door so the Inav could lock on, then said "Hey Siri.. fire the Ibeam." The [[ibeam|Ibeam]] first released an EMP that shut down the building, then a beam blasted through, leaving a hole open to the moonlight and giving DJ Khaled a low taper fade. Inside, the card glowed "with a radiant golden light", and Kanye put it in his Yeezy jacket.

sections.heading: Escape
sections.body: As power returned with red lights and alarms, more Kirks poured down the stairwell. Everyone boarded the Inav via a ladder through the hole. The casino's protection system opened fire, but "the bulleted bounced off of the Inav's white glassy exterior." Steve ordered Siri to take them to the [[turbografx-16-sector|TurboGrafx 16 Sector]], and the Inav escaped through a wormhole.

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body:
- Hank's crew presumably forfeited the 15 gallons of Prime US [[oil]] promised by Bing.
- The Inav's passenger list grew to six.
- Steve began entering the gift card code on arrival in TurboGrafx 16.

title: The Vault
subtitle: Nothing could open it. Then something did.

quote.text: Well how were you planning on getting the vault open? Nothing we have can get into it

lead:
**The Vault** is the chamber in the lower levels of [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]] containing the [[verizon-contract|3 Year Contract Plan from Verizon for Unlimited Talk and Text]]. It is sealed by "the giant freaking door", a "large metal door" in front of which [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]]'s crew lit a fire and slept in beach chairs on guard duty.

The Vault resisted everything its guardians had. During the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]] placed an [[airtag|AirTag]] on the door so the [[inav|Inav]] could target it with the [[ibeam|Ibeam]]. After an EMP blacked out the floor, the beam left "a large hole" through which moonlight came in. Inside, the relic sat "Glowing with a radiant golden light".

The Vault is notable as the only place in the canon where a campfire was lit indoors without incident.

title: The Yeezy Reserve
subtitle: Plenty of oil, allegedly.

quote.text: but why would you want that? You have plenty of oil in the Yeezy reserve-

lead:
**The Yeezy Reserve** is an oil reserve belonging to [[kanye-west|Kanye West]], mentioned once by [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]] during the truce in the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]]. Hank pointed out that the Boys had no need to defeat [[chris|Chris]] for oil, given the reserve, but was interrupted by [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]], who said: "We have other motives" (less regulation and free [[balling]]).

The reserve is consistent with Kanye's business interests in the canon, which include the propane brand [[ye-the-gas|Ye the Gas]] and the [[corner-store-ohio|Corner Store]] selling potato chips at "2.85 a gallon". Given that Hank previously discovered Kanye's [[propane]] was "watered down", some fans doubt the purity of the Yeezy Reserve.

title: Oil
subtitle: The resource behind more of the plot than you'd think.

infobox.Notable grades: Prime US oil; mountain dew oil

quote.text: Hank.. if Chris was defeated then the oil reserves..

lead: **Oil** is a resource that appears throughout the later canon. It is used as a weapon of urban flooding, as a currency for security services, and as a motivation for overthrowing [[chris|Chris]].

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body:
### Constantinople
In [[chapter-triangle]], [[mr-bean|Mr. Bean]] explains that the plan to defeat [[barack-obama|Barack Obama]] involves breaking "the main oil lines to the city causing flooding of the city, once the city is one big oil pool we lure Obamna into the center and light the nukes". The oil part of the plan is not mentioned again during [[fall-of-constantinople|the Fall of Constantinople]].

### Dusty Depot
In the [[flashback-chapter]], Hank's crew were "searching for a oil deposit in [[dusty-depot|dusty depot]] as their oil ran out". A Quick-Check clerk told Jesse of "a oil casino nearby": [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]].

### Prime US oil
Hank demanded "15 gallons of your finest Prime US oil" from [[microsoft-bing|Microsoft Bing]] as payment for guarding the relic. Bing called it "a high price".

### The case against Chris
During the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], Hank explained that since being teleported to Dusty Depot "we haven't had a ounce of oil for our business". Walter realised that if Chris were defeated, the oil reserves "There would be plenty of them, we could drive the cost down exponentially, creating a market almost even over dependent on oil!" Hank then noted that [[kanye-west|Kanye]] already had "plenty of oil in the [[yeezy-reserve|Yeezy reserve]]".

### Mountain dew oil
In [[chapter-4-point-1]], the escape door from the [[chambers-360|360 Chambers]] is "smothered in Dorito dust and mountain dew oil".

sections.heading: Analysis
sections.body:
The canon never explains why Chris's existence restricts the oil supply. Editors have proposed that, since Chris "took balling all for himself", he may have done the same with oil, but this is speculation.

Oil and [[propane]] seem to be interchangeable for Hank's business: Hank says "we ran out of propane" in the same scene where the narration says their oil ran out.

title: The Boys (not the Amazon Prime show)
subtitle: Also the gangity gang, the epic gamers, and the gamers.

infobox.Other names: The gangity gang; epic gamers; the gamers; the gang

quote.text: The boys (not from the the hit amazon prime show) exited the Inav blasting yuno miles In their earth pods pro .5's.

lead: **The Boys** are the trio of [[steve-jobs|Steve Jobs]], [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] and [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]], who travel the multiverse in the [[inav|Inav]] on a quest to defeat [[chris|Chris]]. The narration takes care to state that they are "not from the the hit amazon prime show".

sections.heading: History
sections.body: Kanye and ChatGPT were already a pair before the group formed, working on Kanye's propane brand and later winning [[rap-battle-club-shadowban|the Battle of Club Shadowban]] in [[gotham-city|Gotham City]]. Steve Jobs joined when he arrived on a sideways [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] after "the mixtape… has dropped". The trio then fled Gotham in the Inav and carried out [[casino-heist|the Casino Heist]], acquiring the [[verizon-contract|Verizon contract]] and the temporary company of Hank Hill's crew.

sections.heading: Names
sections.body:
- "the gangity gang" (Steve Jobs's address in [[chapter-maybe-seventh]])
- "epic gamers" (the Inav's arrival announcement: "We're Approaching the drop point epic gamers, buy your battle passes")
- "The gamers"
- "the boys" (by ChatGPT and Steve, frequently)

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body:
- They are one of three main parties working against Chris, alongside the [[new-crips|New Crips]] and the [[goober-gang|Goober Gang]].
- All three members acquire [[igun|Iguns]] during the heist.

title: "Bring Out the Lobster!!"
subtitle: A battle cry, and a garnish.

quote.text: Hank let the security guard deal with this.. BRING OUT THE LOBSTER!!

lead:
**"Bring Out the Lobster!!"** is the battle cry shouted just before [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]] leaps out with his DJ set during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]]. Who said it is never stated. DJ Khaled himself is not a lobster, and no lobster is subsequently brought out, so the phrase is generally understood as a code word for releasing the security guard.

Lobster had appeared once before in the canon. In [[chapter-before-chapter-2|the origin story]], [[frodo|Frodo]] used [[master-chef|master chef]] "to cook the universe into a sirloin steak with lobster tail" and then ate it. This makes lobster one of the few things to appear in both the origin story and the main narrative, alongside [[elon-mush|Elon Mush]].

title: Doritos
subtitle: Grub. Dust. Bass.
lead: **Doritos** are a snack that appears in various forms in the later canon, often alongside [[mountain-dew|Mountain Dew]].

sections.heading: Appearances
sections.body:
- **Wormhole advertising:** When the [[inav|Inav]] entered a wormhole after leaving Gotham, it was "surrounded in a tunnel of Doritos and mountain dew ads, xbox live cod clip comps and skrilla."
- **The Quick-Check:** [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] used a [[port-a-potty-portal|port-a-potty]] "to go to a quick-check to score some Doritos". He returned with Mountain Dews and [[zyn|Zyns]], and the Doritos are not confirmed.
- **Doros bass:** [[dj-khaled|DJ Khaled]] "laid out a sick beat with plenty of doros bass". Most editors take "doros" to mean Doritos.
- **Dorito dust:** In [[chapter-4-point-1]], a mysterious door appeared in the [[chambers-360|360 Chambers]], "smothered in Dorito dust and mountain dew oil". It let [[mf-vroom|MF Vroom]] and the New Crips escape.
- **Pol Phi Doros:** [[osama-bin-bomin|Osama Bin Bomb'in]]'s fraternity, [[pol-phi-doros|Pol Phi Doros]], may also be named after the snack. This is unconfirmed.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.body: Doritos and Mountain Dew are traditionally associated with gamer culture, which the canon celebrates throughout.

title: The Casino Statues
subtitle: Part of the decor.

infobox.Subjects: Jeffrey Epstein, Donald Trump, Bill Clinton

lead:
**The Casino Statues** are part of the decor of [[the-67-casino|The 6 7 Casino]]. When [[hank-hill|Hank Hill]], [[jesse-pinkman|Jesse Pinkman]] and [[walter-white|Walter White]] came through the [[port-a-potty-portal|port-a-potty portal]], they found "a vast casino lined with slot machines, gold decor, statues of jeffery Epstein, Donald trump, and Bill Clinton."

The statues are mentioned only once and play no part in the plot. The canon does not say what they are made of, where in the casino they stand, or why these three figures were chosen. They are not mentioned during the [[casino-heist|Casino Heist]], and whether they survived the [[ibeam|Ibeam]] is unknown.

The narration spells the first name "jeffery".
